days.title: Everyone meets in Florence
days.text:
Marc and Anna travel from Berlin to Florence by FlixBus.

Mo and Paula take the train from Hamburg to Freiburg im Breisgau, then a bus to Milan. Qen, Jonas, David and Michelle travel from Lucerne to Milan by train. Kawan reaches Lucerne by train and joins them; Kawan’s starting point still needs adding.

The seven travelers meet in Milan and continue to Florence on a non-Frecciarossa train. Exact services, connections, departure days and arrival times are still to confirm; these legs are grouped under the Saturday arrival for now.

Proposed overnight: Camping Village Internazionale Firenze (now hu Firenze Certosa camping in town). Everyone meets in Florence; the meeting point and time are open. The map follows representative rail and road corridors. Station-area pins are mapping anchors; exact coach terminals, transfer routes and the Florence meeting point are not yet settled.

days.title: Florence to Fucecchio
days.text:
The first riding day heads towards Fucecchio, with 66 km planned and around 11 km offroad in the supplied notes.

Proposed overnight: Toscana Village Srl in Montopoli in Val d’Arno. Supplied planning pin: 43.678487, 10.767459. The Google Maps campsite pin in the notes is different (43.676046, 10.752759); confirm the approach and whether the distance includes it.

Alternative retained from the notes: a riverside spot near Fucecchio / Roffia. This is an unconfirmed idea; permission and suitability have not been established.

Mapped candidate: 48.2 km on roads and paths between the named destinations. This is a bicycle-router reconstruction, not the unavailable original track; campsite approaches are not included.

days.title: Fucecchio to Lucca
days.text:
A shorter riding day to leave time to explore Lucca, with Pisa mentioned as an optional visit in the notes. Any Pisa detour still needs planning.

Proposed overnight: Agricampeggio La Valle, beyond Lucca. Supplied pin: 43.829140, 10.425546. Alternative from the notes: the forest behind the campsite, with permission and suitability unconfirmed.

The notes describe the ride as straightforward on EuroVelo 5. The exact alignment, campsite access and 46 km estimate still need checking against the track.

Mapped candidate: 34.6 km on roads and paths between the named destinations. This is a bicycle-router reconstruction, not the unavailable original track; campsite approaches are not included.

days.title: Lucca to the Massa coast
days.text:
Continue towards Marina di Massa. The revised table uses Massa and 54 km, replacing the earlier Marina di Carrara entry.

Proposed overnight: Camping Lilly Pineta. Supplied planning pin: 44.028501, 10.077718. The linked campsite pin is 44.025105, 10.077470; confirm the entrance.

The notes again suggest a straightforward day following EuroVelo 5. This is retained as a route note, not a verified alignment.

Mapped candidate: 48.8 km on roads and paths between the named destinations. This is a bicycle-router reconstruction, not the unavailable original track; campsite approaches are not included.

days.title: Towards Mattarana
days.text:
The longest listed stage follows the easier opening days. The notes flag more climbing here; the tested coastal alternative reportedly adds around 30 km with similar elevation. No elevation total has been imported.

The destination is Mattarana, but the proposed Camping Oasi Holiday Park is at Passo delle Campane near Sestri Levante (official pin: 44.258050, 9.493494), farther west. The supplied planning pin is 44.264809, 9.505556. This mismatch must be resolved before choosing the stage endpoint or overnight.

Alternative from the notes: a nearby forest or riverside spot, with permission and suitability unconfirmed. The older note about resting in Genoa the next day conflicts with the revised Thursday in Sestri Levante; no extra rest day has been inserted.

Mapped candidate: 60.8 km on roads and paths between the named destinations. This is a bicycle-router reconstruction, not the unavailable original track; campsite approaches are not included.

days.title: Mattarana to Sestri Levante
days.text:
The revised itinerary ends at Sestri Levante and names Camping Mare Monti, replacing the earlier Pian dei Manzi plan. Supplied campsite pin: 44.263141, 9.442277.

The notes describe a beautiful final stretch with some tricky unpaved roads. It is not yet clear whether this comment and the linked Komoot suggestion refer to the earlier route or this revision.

The supplied plan estimates 62 km. The exact track and Wednesday’s overnight are needed to explain this distance and establish the actual start of the day.

Mapped candidate: 25.8 km on roads and paths between the named destinations. This is a bicycle-router reconstruction, not the unavailable original track; campsite approaches are not included.

days.title: Sestri Levante to Genoa
days.text:
Finish in Genoa, with 62–72 km in the revised plan. Proposed overnight: Airbnb in Genoa; booking status is unconfirmed.

A shorter coastal option is mentioned, with roughly 35–45 km on busy roads with cars. Keep that tradeoff visible until the exact route is available.

The original six-day cycling plan totals 364–374 km. The mapped town-to-town reconstruction totals 300.0 km before campsite approaches and other detours. Route statistics now measure the mapped reconstruction, including the separate arrival routes when they are selected.
